provenance.zero_findings_caveat: The original Core-driven SDK scan of packaged L9 rules returned 0 findings. A later finding-bearing resolver revision (2410fae, finding_count=1) plus resolver feedback produced snapshot record_count=2. That is enough for the compiler to emit candidates (candidate_count=2) but not enough for promotion (promotion_eligible_count=0: one producer, one scope). Do not read this as a 0-finding corpus.

failures.summary: The full producer chain ran, but no candidate is promotion-eligible, so the publication gate fail-closed. Correct behaviour; the seam is unproven for lack of corpus maturity, not for lack of a working path. Per the seam receipt: record_count=2, candidate_count=2, promotion_eligible_count=0 — one producer and one scope, so the recurrence threshold cannot be met by construction.
failures.superseded_summary: Earlier text said '1 record from a real 0-finding SDK bundle'. That was true before the resolver feedback event was ingested; the corpus then held 2 records.

credential_finding.claim_retracted: This surface DOES hold a working GitHub credential. GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN are a 14-character sentinel, yet REST calls carrying them return 200 because the agent proxy supplies real authentication out of band - exactly as CANONICAL_LAW's surface-transport section records.
credential_finding.consequence: Two of the three Layer 2 non-pass results were originally attributed to missing credentials. The resolver attribution was a repo defect (fixed). The GraphQL 403 on pr_repair_standalone does not reproduce on this rerun: live ingest-review succeeded with a bound token. intelligence_to_lsp remains a corpus-maturity gate, not a credential failure.
credential_finding.github_actions_secrets: Repository/organization Actions secrets are NOT readable from any session: the API is write-only by GitHub's design, and this proxy additionally returns 403 for /actions/secrets. A secret 'wired into the repo' can only be consumed by a workflow run, never handed to a local tool.

milestone.first_non_zero_finding: Revision 2410fae622bb of l9-ci-debt-resolver yields finding_count=1 - the first non-zero finding to traverse the organism in this run. Every prior scan (654 files organism-wide, plus semgrep's p/python registry ruleset) returned 0, which is what had kept the finding-carrying path proven only structurally.
